# Moon Arc Works

> Moon Arc Works is an independent studio that makes mobile apps and games for iPhone and Android, each written for 34 languages. Its apps are AirAgain, a quit smoking and vaping app launching on the App Store and Google Play on 7 December 2026, and Petiverse, a pet health and safety app for cat and dog owners. Its first game, Fluffytail: Squirrel Adventure, a 3D platformer for kids aged 6 to 8, is coming soon.

## AirAgain: quit smoking and vaping

AirAgain helps people quit cigarettes and vapes: a smoke-free counter, money saved at real pack prices for 101 countries, a 30-day quit plan, a 3-minute craving rescue, a health recovery timeline and badges. It needs no account (data stays on the phone) and is free with ads; AirAgain Plus removes ads and opens the full 30-day program.

- [AirAgain (English)](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/): the app, the savings calculator and FAQ
- [AirAgain in all 34 languages](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/): pick a language
- [AirAgain (Türkçe)](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/tr/)

## Guides

- [Nicotine withdrawal: symptoms and how long they last](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/guides/nicotine-withdrawal/)
- [How to beat a craving](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/guides/beat-a-craving/)
- [How to quit: a plan](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/guides/how-to-quit/)
- [What happens when you quit: the timeline](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/guides/what-happens-when-you-quit/)

## Cost of smoking by country

The typical price of a pack of 20 cigarettes in 101 countries, and what a pack or half a pack a day costs per month, year and decade. Prices are the app's own feed, updated when taxes change.

- [Cigarette prices by country](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/cost-of-smoking/)
- Country pages follow the pattern https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/cost-of-smoking/<country>/ (for example [Germany](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/cost-of-smoking/germany/), [Japan](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/cost-of-smoking/japan/), [Türkiye](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/en/cost-of-smoking/turkiye/))
- Price data, free to reuse under CC BY 4.0 (credit AirAgain by Moon Arc Works): [CSV](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/data/cigarette-prices.csv), [JSON](https://moonarcworks.com/airagain/prices.json)

## Petiverse: pet health card, nearest vet and lost-pet kit

Petiverse is a free app for cat and dog owners on iPhone and Android, in 34 languages. It keeps a pet's health card (vaccines with the next dates worked out and reminded, weight, expenses, documents, a PDF report for the vet), finds the nearest vets, pet shops, groomers and parks (24/7 clinics first in an emergency, with offline first-aid cards), checks symptoms (see a vet now, today, or watch at home; never a diagnosis or a dose), answers "is this food or plant toxic for my cat or dog?" offline, and has a lost-pet kit that is always free: a printable poster, a share message and a QR collar tag whose details live in the link, not on a server. No account; the data stays on the phone. An optional paid tier adds the PDF health report, sitter card and expense insights.

- [Petiverse (English)](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/): the app, features and FAQ
- [Petiverse (Türkçe)](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/tr/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758307180) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.petiverse.mobile)
- [Privacy policy](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/privacy/) · [Support](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/support/)

## Is it toxic for cats and dogs?

A reference of common foods, drinks and plants with separate answers for cats and dogs (toxic, caution or safe), the symptoms to watch for and what to do. Same data as the app's offline checker, in 34 languages.

- [Is it toxic? (English index)](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/toxic/)
- Item pages follow the pattern https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/toxic/<item>/ (for example [chocolate](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/toxic/chocolate/), [grapes and raisins](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/toxic/grapes_raisins/), [onion](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/toxic/onion/)); other languages add the language code, e.g. https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/tr/toxic/chocolate/

## Pet first aid and calculators

Free pages in 34 languages, built from the app's own first-aid cards and formulas.

- [First aid for cats and dogs](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/first-aid/): the first steps on the way to the vet for poisoning, heatstroke, choking, bleeding, trouble breathing, seizures, a car accident or fall, and burns
- [How much should I feed my dog or cat?](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/food-calculator/): daily calories (RER/MER method), dry food amount, meals per day and water by weight, age, neuter status and activity, with a chart by weight
- [Dog and cat years in human years](https://moonarcworks.com/petiverse/age-calculator/): a calculator and a chart from 1 to 20 years

## Fluffytail: Squirrel Adventure

A 3D platformer for kids aged 6 to 8 (Fluffytail: Sincap Macerası in Turkish): a little squirrel runs, climbs and glides through five worlds, all the way to the Moon, to bring little Peanut, stolen away by a fox, back home. No ads, no tracking, no accounts, no chat; it works offline and collects no personal data. The first two chapters are free; one optional purchase, behind a grown-up question, unlocks the Full Adventure. iPhone, iPad and Android, 34 languages. Coming soon.

- [Fluffytail (English)](https://moonarcworks.com/fluffytail/)
- [Fluffytail: Sincap Macerası (Türkçe)](https://moonarcworks.com/tr/fluffytail/)
- [Privacy policy](https://moonarcworks.com/fluffytail/privacy/)
- [Support and FAQ for parents](https://moonarcworks.com/fluffytail/support/)
